The Disenchanting Tables' Void essence find: a same-id copy of RPG Stations' own Disenchant_Void (both jar actions already list it, so no extension names it), carrying the jar's Void essence roll unchanged (gear of item level 20 and up, 2 percent plus 0.4 per item level under a 30 ceiling, one or two essence; a jar retune of it means copying it here again). The jar's flat Voidheart roll, which shares the jar's file, lives in Mmo_Disenchant_Voidheart_Base instead, so this table can carry a Requires of its own: Kit Rite (an Enchanting talent, a face of the Seeker's Rite, read off the talent's own record, ziggfreedcommon:track_pick) trades the Void finds away for a second roll of the kit, and the Not shuts this table for that talent's holder alone, so everyone else, and a server with Enchanting switched off or no Enchanting track at all, is paid as always. Void Rite and Treasure Hunter roll it again from Mmo_Disenchant_Seekers.

Every chance is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.
